summary: The composer and the posting pages as SwiftUI screens.

src/posting/composer/Composer.jsx.note: Ported: opening from an intent (normalizeIntent, seedFromIntent, setting aside what was being written, the notices), restoring what was kept (keptPostFor, takeSetAside, openAside, elsewhereNotices), loading a reply or a quote, posting as another account (changeAsDid, gatesForAccount), the default reply settings, adding pictures (picked, pasted, an intent's described ones) and a video (uploaded as soon as it's added), quotes and link cards found in the text, splitting, renumbering and its undo, removing and adding posts, the settings row (tags, language, replies, timer, More › Start over), the busy line, the slow and hard publish watch, publishErrorView, the posted toast and resetting after a send, the autosave (flushed on Close and when the app goes to the background). Publishing goes through ComposerPublisher (VirgaUI/Composer/ComposerServices.swift); until publish.js's port is wired, UnavailablePublisher shows the web's busy line and then says publishing isn't in the iOS app yet, and Schedule, Add to queue and Save as draft do the same. Link cards come through ComposerLinkCards, a stand-in for linkCard.js's fetchLinkCard over the session's transport. Not yet, because what they call isn't ported: scheduling and the weekly queue (WhenPicker, the queue's next slot, submitSchedule), drafts (saveDraft, loading a draft or a scheduled post, the draft media store, finishSource), the timer (LifespanEditor, getLimits, the default timer, armAfterPublish), the adviser (Check this post, the gate before posting), the library and templates (applyPlan, applyTemplate, Save as a template, Continue a thread), the duplicate guard (publish.js's), drag and drop, and the posted toast's View it on Bluesky link (the shell's toasts are words only). On a phone the main button is in the foot under the thumb (ios/DESIGN.md), not in the web's top bar.

src/posting/composer/ComposerDialogs.jsx.note: ConfirmDialog, MetaDialog, GatesDialog and VideoAltDialog are ported. LifespanDialog says the timer isn't in the iOS app yet (LifespanEditor.jsx isn't ported); ContinueThreadDialog waits for the library's sources (readArchivePosts, fetchOwnPosts).

src/posting/composer/LanguagePicker.jsx.note: Return adds the first suggestion; a hardware keyboard's arrows don't move through them.

src/posting/composer/PostBlock.jsx.note: PostTools' library button (Quote or attach from your library) waits for the library's port; pictures and a video come from PhotosPicker.

src/posting/composer/PostEditor.jsx.note: The highlights are attributes on a UITextView's own text rather than a layer under a transparent textarea. Not yet: the "/" templates (library/model.js's detectSlashCommand, rankTemplatesForSlash and applying a template aren't ported), and a hardware keyboard's arrows through the mention suggestions.

src/posting/composer/TagsField.jsx.note: Backspace in an empty field doesn't take the last tag off (SwiftUI's TextField doesn't say when it's pressed).

src/posting/library/TemplateEditor.jsx.note: The editor as a full-height sheet, its foot held under the form: the note, a seed's note, Name, Text with Insert (A blank… and the four context inserts) and its count against 300, naming a new blank in place (Add, Don’t add a blank), the hint; Questions for each blank asked (its key, Question and Example or hint side by side from 640 wide, Typed answer or Pick from a list, the choices one per line, Optional) and what fills itself; Attach (Nothing, One of your posts with the recent ones five at a time and Show more, A link with Read the link; what it attaches named, Gone, the other kind kept with Remove it); Offer it when; Group and Shortcut; Suggest it when a post mentions; the server's refusal (with Sign in again for a permission) and the fields' own; and the foot: Delete, Cancel, Save template, or Discard your changes? / Delete … for good? in its place, Escape putting a prompt away. Saved through TemplatesModel with its toasts. The editor's reads (fetchOwnPosts, hydrateEmbedViews, resolveRecordLink) are written in TemplateEditorSources over VirgaNetwork's PublicAppView until sources.js is ported. Not yet: a web page's link card (linkCard.js's fetchLinkCard, the publish domain's), so such a link says it couldn't be read; the caret (SwiftUI's text editor doesn't give it on iOS 17, so Insert and a blank go at the end of the text); the groups already used offered under Group (a datalist). A swipe down is held while there are changes.

src/posting/library/TemplateQuestions.js.note: TemplateQuestions (a field per typed question, ChoiceGroup per choice question with the arrows, Home and End and choosing again to clear an optional one, · optional, the hint and note, Answer this one first., Return going to the next unanswered question, the count of those still to answer read out), ChoiceGroup and TemplatePreview (Your post / Your reply will read, the count against 300, added words, what fills itself underlined, answers on the accent's tint, blanks to answer, the attachment's card, the notes and what stops it). The preview is the caller's, or LibraryPreview.forTemplate: previewFor for a template on its own (its words into an empty post, nothing attached), written here until library/model.js is ported. Not yet: the preview within a post under way (state, postIndex, insertion), which waits for model.js's previewFor, and templateContextFrom (the caller passes a template context).

src/posting/pages/TemplatesPage.jsx.note: The page over the account's own TemplatesModel (useTemplates) and TemplateUsage (readTemplateUsage, sortTemplatesForShelf): the permission notice with Sign in again when the sign-in can't write templates; the read-again failure over the last ones seen; the bones while the first read runs; the failure with Try again; No templates yet with New template; then the count and its line with New template, the groups (Other templates for those without one), and each row: the name as the way into the editor with its /shortcut, Use and the ⋯ (Edit, Delete with its dialog and toast) on the name's line, the words with each blank marked (named as it is asked, or as it fills itself; No text: it only attaches something), and the facts (who it's for, the questions, what it attaches, the words that suggest it, how often it was used here). The editor is TemplateEditor. Use opens the composer (ComposerHost) with the template's intent; the composer reads the template once library/model.js is ported. iOS additions: /posting/templates/new and /posting/templates/<rkey> open the editor. A blank's chip is drawn on a tint in the run of words; the focus after a delete is the system's.

src/posting/pages/hubParts.jsx.note: RowSkeleton, LoadError and ConfirmDialog (busy, and a refusal's message kept in the dialog). The rest (the post rows, the posting nav, the long-session notice) come with the pages that use them.

src/posting/ui/AltTextDialog.jsx.note: The writer's part: the image, its description and the count. Describing and revising it for the writer needs the adviser's AI service (aiService.js, altTextModel.js, altTextFollowUp.js), not ported; the web shows no Generate button without a server requester either. ALT_TEXT_MAX_GRAPHEMES is written here until altTextModel.js's port.

src/posting/ui/PostPreview.jsx.note: Only the compact form the composer uses (who wrote it and its words), read straight from the view: postPreview.js isn't ported, so there's no time, embed line or counts.

src/posting/ui/PostingHeader.jsx.note: The header's model (Posting in the crumbs except on the overview, the page's title and line, what it touches, or not), used by Templates and every posting page not here yet. Not yet: a caller's own crumbs, title, line, actions and children.
